classes.name: ParsedSqlFile
classes.description: Represents a parsed SQL file with its statements and source path.

classes.name: StmtWithParams
classes.description: Represents a single SQL statement with parameters, position, delayed functions, and JSON columns.

classes.name: SourceSpan
classes.description: Defines the start and end locations of a source code span.

classes.name: SourceLocation
classes.description: Represents a specific location in source code by line and column.

classes.name: ParsedStatement
classes.description: Enumerates different types of parsed SQL statements, including errors and static/expression-based statements.

classes.name: SimpleSelectValue
classes.description: Represents a value in a simple select, either static JSON or dynamic parameter.

classes.name: DelayedFunctionCall
classes.description: Represents a function call delayed until after query execution, with argument columns and target column.

classes.name: FormatArguments
classes.description: Helper for formatting function arguments in error messages.

classes.name: ParameterExtractor
classes.description: Handles extraction and replacement of parameters in SQL AST.

methods.description: Creates a new ParsedSqlFile by parsing SQL source with error handling.

methods.name: from_err
methods.description: Creates a ParsedSqlFile from an error, marking it as an error statement.

methods.name: from_str_with_state
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a ParsedSqlFile from a string source with application state.
